Also, are requests typically ~512 tokens per inference or do you see longer sequences sometimes?

- Thu 2026-11-04 09:00–09:45
- Thu 2026-11-04 13:30–14:15

Vanessa — thanks for the quick reply. The 250–500 QPS is expected as peak sustained during business hours (we expect diurnal patterns). Steady-state during off-peak is around 60–80 QPS. Average request size is ~512 tokens but some batch jobs send sequences up to ~1,200 tokens.

Primary constraints: 99th-pct latency target <= 300ms for interactive workloads (mostly single-request flows), and cost sensitivity for high-volume async batch loads. We’re open to a short SE call this Thursday; the 13:30 slot would work best on our side.

Also: can you confirm whether Redwood supports pinned model versions across Dedicated pools and what the topology would look like for KV cache pinning across replicas? We can provide a brief summary doc if helpful.

Thanks,
Sam
